title: Scaffold the Firebase core: emulator suite, Cloud Functions, App Hosting config (+ optionally the client on one app)

project.description: Optional. Also attach the Firebase CLIENT to this app (composes the firebase-client generator — environment files, SDK initialisation, its bootstrap provider, through the app's stack adapter), and make it the suite's client app. Omit it for the framework-neutral core alone.

workspaceName.description: Workspace name used to build the FALLBACK offline emulator project id (`demo-<name>`). Defaults to --project, else the workspace's identity — its directory's name in the repository's main worktree, even when run from a linked worktree. (Not written to .firebaserc — that's the Firebase CLI's responsibility.)

staging.description: Opt-in: also write apphosting.staging.yaml (builds the client app's `--configuration=staging`) and, with --project, the client's staging env bundle. Default false.

wireProviders.description: Wire this layer's provider into the app's app.config.ts. TRUE ONLY WHEN ENSURING the layer (creating the capability) — app.config.ts is seeded, never owned, so a detect-only sync must not write to it. Any later provider change ships as a migration. Default false.

clientApp.description: The app whose environment files the suite's scripts (tools/emulators.sh, tools/push-secrets.sh) derive project ids from, WITHOUT attaching anything to it. Defaults to --project, else the app already wired with the Firebase client, else none (the scripts then fall back to demo-<workspaceName> / .firebaserc).

seedRules.description: Seed deny-all Firestore rules and Storage rules into the `firebase` project (and declare them in firebase.json) for each service firebase.json declares none for. TRUE ONLY WHEN THIS RUN CREATES the layer (`new`, or `add-layer firebase` on a project without it) — never on an upgrade or a re-ensure: a project with no rules in the repo keeps them in the Firebase console (the first deploy would overwrite them) and its local emulators run open (deny-all would break them). The seeds carry a marker line; `nx run firebase:deploy` skips a file that still has it. Never an indexes file: a forced deploy deletes every live index the file does not list. Default false.
